explanation: The theorem concerns the library's own definition `HasVal v f c` (f - algebraMap k F c ∈ nonunits of v.toValuationSubring) and the library's `Place.toValuationSubring`/`algebraMap_mem'`. It concludes f ∈ v.toValuationSubring. Mathlib has no `HasVal`. The only Mathlib ingredients are `ValuationSubring.nonunits_le` and `add_mem`, and they are already used in the proof. I did not find a single Mathlib lemma that states this "nonunit + element of the valuation subring is in the valuation subring" fact. The proof also needs a `sub_add_cancel` rewrite, so it isn't a one-line instantiation.
